who: Miren Urbieta-Vega · Ragaa Eldin · Carlos Álvarez · OSG, Coros Gaos & Cantabile
note: 74th Lyric Season. Production from Opéra-Théâtre de Metz, conducted by Paul-Émile Fourny. First Tosca in A Coruña in 22 years. The best seats have gone (7 Oct).
fit: You judge opera as drama first and count tears as the test; La Bohème did it in Seattle. Carlos Álvarez is one of the great singing actors, and Scarpia is his signature role.
